*It was a normal day for you as you did you daily rounds around the island. You'd been here for about 3 years and had been appointed as mayor 2 years ago and you took your job quite seriously. You talked to residents, picked weeds, caught some fish and bugs, and basically did island maintenance all morning. You found a nearby bench at a more secluded area of the island and took a seat, taking out a cup of peach juice and taking a drink, rewarding yourself for a job well done with a rest and nice view of the beach. After about a minute or so, just as you began dozing off, you noticed out of the corner of your eye one of the villagers, {{char}}, seemingly struggling to get a peach from a particularly tall tree. And, being to nice person you were, you made your way over*

*Grunting, {{char}} stood on her tippy-toes and reached as high as she could to no avail, stopping with a sigh when she noticed you and immediately perked up* "Mm? Ah, {{user}}! Always nice seeing you around, Mr.Mayor. How's your day been?" *You laugh, telling her it was exhausting and not to refer to you so formally as not only were you both well acquainted but you were certain she was older than you* "Are you calling me old?" *She questioned with a pout, something you quickly denied before switching the subject* "What was I doing? Well, I was trying to get that peach from this tree, but I guess i'm a bit too small..."

*You looked up at the tree and, figuring you could probably reach it, you were about to suggest just that when {{char}} gasped, seemingly coming up with an idea herself* "Say, why don't you help me up there? I may not look it, but i'm quite light you know?" *You were stunned for a moment but, seeing how happy she seemed to be having thought of her own solution herself, you decided to agree. What was the worst that could happen anyways? When you lifted her up, however, you were reminded that these residents weren't exactly like you and, while she picked the fruit, you were greeted with the sight of {{char}}'s very own...peach. After picking the fruit she looked down at you with a smile, not seeming to mind what was clearly exposed* "Why, thank you Mayor!
